FRIERENMOD-HOLY_EMBLEM.title: Holy Emblem
FRIERENMOD-HOLY_EMBLEM.description: At the start of each turn, add 1 [gold]Mana[/gold] to your draw and discard piles.
FRIERENMOD-HOLY_EMBLEM.flavor: Magic gathered over a long journey.
FRIERENMOD-EAR_ACCESSORY.title: Elegant Ear Ornament
FRIERENMOD-EAR_ACCESSORY.description: At the start of combat, add 2 [gold]Mana[/gold] to your hand.
FRIERENMOD-EAR_ACCESSORY.flavor: The ornament Frieren has been wearing all along, it seems to match the style of the one worn by her master, Flamme.
FRIERENMOD-FAKE_FLAMME_GRIMOIRE.title: Flamme's Grimoire(Fake)
FRIERENMOD-FAKE_FLAMME_GRIMOIRE.descript: On the first turn of combat, you can play [gold]Legendary Spells[/gold] without first playing a [gold]Chant[/gold] card.
FRIERENMOD-FAKE_FLAMME_GRIMOIRE.flavor: Books attributed to Flamme are never real，But maybe you can find the real one in some secret place...
FRIERENMOD-FLAMME_GRIMOIRE.title: Flamme's Grimoire
FRIERENMOD-FLAMME_GRIMOIRE.description: You can play [gold]Legendary Spells[/gold] without first playing a [gold]Chant[/gold] card.
FRIERENMOD-FLAMME_GRIMOIRE.flavor: On the northernmost end of the continent, I arrived at the place the people of this world call heaven: Aureole, the land where souls rest...
FRIERENMOD-HAIR_ACCESSORY.title: Fern's Hair Ornament
FRIERENMOD-HAIR_ACCESSORY.flavor: It is the 16 years old Birthday present Frieren give to Fern, her apprentice.
FRIERENMOD-HAITAA_WAND.title: Heiter's Staff
FRIERENMOD-HAITAA_WAND.description: Deprecated. Cannot be obtained and has no effect.
FRIERENMOD-HAITAA_WAND.flavor: A staff left behind by Heiter.
FRIERENMOD-HIMMEL_GRAVESTONE.title: Himmel's Gravestone
FRIERENMOD-HIMMEL_GRAVESTONE.description: Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} at the start of each turn. Upon pickup, add [gold]The Pain of Longevity[/gold] to your deck.
FRIERENMOD-HIMMEL_GRAVESTONE.flavor: Himmel was the Hero of the Hero Party, defeated the Demon King and created an era of peace. After his death from old age, Frieren resolves to get to know Humans better.
FRIERENMOD-ICICLE_CHERRY_BLOSSOM.title: Icicle Cherry Blossom
FRIERENMOD-ICICLE_CHERRY_BLOSSOM.descrip: Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} at the start of each turn. Each card offered in a card reward has a 60% chance to be replaced with [gold]Mana[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-ICICLE_CHERRY_BLOSSOM.flavor: Icicle Cherry Blossom blooms in winter, although their flowers are poisonous, they are very beautiful. It is also Frieren's favorite winter flower.
FRIERENMOD-IMMOVABLE_CLOAK.title: Immovable Cloak
FRIERENMOD-IMMOVABLE_CLOAK.description: Draw 1 additional card each turn until you lose HP during combat.
FRIERENMOD-IMMOVABLE_CLOAK.flavor: Worn by First-class Mage Burg, a specialist in defensive magic, the defense techniques layered on it were so powerful that ordinary students can't even make him move.
FRIERENMOD-MERCURY_PUDDING.title: Mercury Pudding
FRIERENMOD-MERCURY_PUDDING.description: At the end of combat, if you have 10 HP or less, heal 50% of your max HP. Works only once.
FRIERENMOD-MERCURY_PUDDING.flavor: The dessert Frieren often ordered. It is also one of the trigger Frieren wants to know about human.
FRIERENMOD-MICKEY_HOUSE.title: Unbelievable House
FRIERENMOD-MICKEY_HOUSE.description: Whenever you enter an event room, gain an [gold]Unbelievable Tool[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-MICKEY_HOUSE.flavor: You can always find some unbelievable tools in this house
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_HEAD.title: Mimic's Head
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_HEAD.description: Whenever you open a non-Boss chest, gain 100 additional Gold.
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_HEAD.flavor: There is a rumor in some dark place that wearing mimic's head will drop more rewards. Yippee! Frieren fell into the mimic's mouth once again.
FRIERENMOD-MIRRORED_LOTUS_RING.title: Mirrored-Lotus Ring
FRIERENMOD-MIRRORED_LOTUS_RING.descripti: At the start of turn 4, add [gold]Himmel[/gold] to your hand.
FRIERENMOD-MIRRORED_LOTUS_RING.flavor: The ring Himmel put on Frieren which is casually chosen by her, after Himmel's death did she realize that the language of mirrored-lotus is Eternal Love.
FRIERENMOD-OLD_HAIR_ACCESSORY.title: Fern's Hair Ornament
FRIERENMOD-OLD_HAIR_ACCESSORY.descriptio: Every 4 times you [gold]Synchro[/gold], draw 1 card. Resets each combat.
FRIERENMOD-OLD_HAIR_ACCESSORY.flavor: It is the 16 years old Birthday present Frieren give to Fern, her apprentice.
FRIERENMOD-SCALE_OF_OBEDIENCE.title: Scale Of Obedience
FRIERENMOD-SCALE_OF_OBEDIENCE.descriptio: During normal combats, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and draw 1 card at the start of your turn.
FRIERENMOD-SCALE_OF_OBEDIENCE.flavor: Magic item owned by One of the Seven Sages of Destruction, Aura the Guillotine, she weighs the mana of her opponent's soul on it, the weak one will be completely controlled by the strong one.
FRIERENMOD-STATUE_OF_HIMMEL.title: Statue Of Himmel
FRIERENMOD-STATUE_OF_HIMMEL.description: At the start of each of your first 3 turns, gain 1 [gold]Artifact[/gold] if you have none.
FRIERENMOD-STATUE_OF_HIMMEL.flavor: Himmel built his statue in various places to make the world and Frieren remember him. His statues are still cherished by people, even after a hundred years.
FRIERENMOD-STILLE.title: Stille
FRIERENMOD-STILLE.description: At the start of combat, gain 2 [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. At the end of turn 3, lose 2 [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-STILLE.flavor: Its maximum flight speed can exceed the speed of sound and is very sensitive to mana. Frieren successfully captured one by bird catching magic during the exam.
FRIERENMOD-UBEL_STAFF.title: Übel's Staff
FRIERENMOD-UBEL_STAFF.description: Every 6 [gold]Chant[/gold] cards played, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}. Progress carries over between combats.
FRIERENMOD-UBEL_STAFF.flavor: Übel is known for her unique magical talent of resonance and Spell that slashes almost anything. The slash from the staff once sliced through the Immovable Cloak and the First-class Mage Burg who wore it
FRIERENMOD-COMFORTABLE_BED.title: Comfortable Bed
FRIERENMOD-COMFORTABLE_BED.description: Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} at the start of each turn. At the start of combat, add a [gold]Laziness[/gold] to your draw pile and discard pile.
FRIERENMOD-COMFORTABLE_BED.flavor: Even the great mage who has lived for over a thousand years makes it impossible for to break free from its constraints, indicating its great power.
FRIERENMOD-UPGRADED_HOLY_EMBLEM.title: Upgraded Holy Emblem
FRIERENMOD-UPGRADED_HOLY_EMBLEM.descript: At the start of each turn, add 1 [gold]Mana[/gold] to your draw pile, hand, and discard pile.
FRIERENMOD-KRAFT_SERPENT_RING.title: Ring of the Serpent
FRIERENMOD-AURA_COMPANION.title: Aura’s Company
